geometry.architecture: Six driven, independently steerable wheel pods on passive spring-damper suspension; steering/suspension hardware unselected. No skid-steer zero-radius promise.
geometry_warnings: 1.8m is straight-wheel transport envelope only; steering sweep exceeds it.
Motor inboard projection and full suspension/steering sweep can collide with battery/frame; packaging interference not solved.
Ground clearance, travel and compact deck targets require actual suspension geometry, not visual overlap.
Wheel radius alone does not prove step-climb ability.
